 Info Who we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group.  You identify customer needs and pain points at scale through behavioral data, user research, and market trends, and prioritize the opportunities that create the most value
 You stay on top of AI and e-commerce trends and proactively identify how emerging technologies can create value for our customers
 

 Profil Your profile – this is what we expect from you You have a true builder mindset and a passion for turning ideas into reality
 You've successfully taken a product from scratch, owning everything from early ideation and concept development to execution and delivery
 You have hands-on experience building LLM-based features into consumer products, not just using AI tools for your own productivity 
 You bring solid B2C product experience, ideally in e-commerce or another consumer product at scale
 You are data savvy and outcome-focused: you design and evaluate A/B tests, define tracking concepts, and answer the right questions based on data
 You always think customer first: you have a strong feel for UX, understand end-users' pain points, and derive actionable insights from research and data

 You thrive in a fast-paced, pragmatic environment, bring fluent English skills (C1 level), and excel in an international, remote setup
 

 Benefits What we offer Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
 Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios : Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more

 ‘ Deutschlandticket’: We subsidise your train season ticket for more mobility

 Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it's up to you

jobs.title: Project Manager |  Customer Engagement & Communication (H/F)
jobs.description:
🤝 Qui nous sommes 

 Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine.

 Concrètement, Moka.Care offre une solution complète de prévention en santé mentale :

 Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams.

 Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts.

 Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care , bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.

 Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession.

 La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.

 

 
 🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi 

 Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

 
 Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH.

 Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.

 Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.

 
 Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.

 

 
 👉 Tes futures missions 

 Engagement clients 

 
 
 Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...

 Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.

 Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés.

 
 
 Engagement utilisateurs 

 
 Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés.

 Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care.

 Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app...

 
 
 Notoriété et thought leadership 

 
 Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care.

 Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients.

 Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.

 
 

 L'entraide est très importante chez Moka. 

 De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

 📇 Tu es la personne idéale si 

 
 Tu as au moins 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en communication externe et/ou interne. 

 Tu es à l'aise à l'oral , et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants.

 Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie , organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives.

 Tu fais preuve de professionnalisme et d’un vrai sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées.

 Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils de design (nous utilisons Figma ). Si tu as des compétences en montage vidéo , c’est un vrai plus.

 Tu as le sens du storytelling et du mot qui fait mouche.

 Tu disposes d’un bon niveau d’anglais , te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles.

 
 🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas 

 
 Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte.

 Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire.

 Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail, et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen de la prévention en santé mentale au travail. 

 Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care.

 Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin.

 
 🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) MarTech, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben Zahlen, Tools und der Blick dahinter: Du machst sichtbar, was im Marketing wirkt. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege unserer Dashboards und unseres MarTech-Stacks, hältst Marketingdaten nachvollziehbar und unterstützt bei ersten KI-gestützten Automatisierungen. Dabei arbeitest du mit klaren Datenregeln, unter Anleitung und in Abstimmung mit Marketing, Vertrieb, IT und Datenschutz. Wenn dich reizt, wie aus Kanaldaten belastbare Entscheidungen werden, bist du hier richtig.
 Das erwartet dich. 

Reporting & Dashboards
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege von Dashboards und kanalspezifischen Kennzahlen auf Basis von Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads und LinkedIn. Du stellst sicher, dass Kampagnen mit einer konsistenten UTM-Systematik gekennzeichnet sind und die verwendeten Definitionen dokumentiert werden. 
 Du bereitest die monatlichen Marketingkennzahlen auf, prüfst Daten auf Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität und hilfst, verlässliche Ausgangswerte sowie Trends je Kanal zu etablieren. Abweichungen und Datenlücken dokumentierst du und stimmst sie mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern ab.
  
Analyse & Optimierung
 Du bist analytische Ansprechperson für die Performance unserer Kanäle und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Optimierungen ab.
 Du unterstützt bei einer konsistenten UTM-Systematik, prüfst Kampagnenkennzeichnungen regelmäßig und dokumentierst Änderungen, Annahmen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar.
 Du bereitest Insights verständlich für das Team auf und erstellst kurze Anleitungen oder Einführungen für wiederkehrende Reports und Tools. Bei komplexen oder systemkritischen Themen arbeitest du mit den zuständigen Expert:innen zusammen.
 Du unterstützt dabei, unsere Sichtbarkeit in ausgewählten KI-Antworten und KI-Suchen systematisch zu beobachten. Du dokumentierst Suchanfragen, Ergebnisse und Veränderungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team erste Hypothesen und Content-Maßnahmen ab.
 
 MarTech & Automatisierung
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres MarTech-Stacks. Dazu gehören die strukturierte Dokumentation eingesetzter Analytics- und Automatisierungstools, die Prüfung von Anforderungen sowie vorbereitende Tests und Abstimmungen für Systemanbindungen. Technische Architektur und produktive Änderungen erfolgen mit den zuständigen Verantwortlichen.
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau der Marketing-Datenanbindung an unser CRM, in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Vertriebsteam und unter Einhaltung der Datenschutzvorgaben.
 Du unterstützt bei der Pflege und Qualitätssicherung unseres Trackings und Remarketings im Rahmen der freigegebenen Konzepte. Dabei dokumentierst du Messpunkte, prüfst die technische Funktion und meldest Abweichungen. Alle Maßnahmen erfolgen unter Beachtung der geltenden Datenschutz- und Einwilligungsvorgaben sowie in Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Verantwortlichen.
 Du unterstützt beim Konzipieren, Testen und Dokumentieren erster KI-gestützter Automatisierungen für wiederkehrende Marketingabläufe – unter Anleitung, mit klaren Datenregeln und definierten Freigaben. Du prüfst die Ergebnisse vor der Nutzung und entwickelst keine Automatisierungen, die ungeprüft externe Kommunikation auslösen oder sensible Daten verarbeiten.
 

 Dein Profil Du bist eingeschrieben in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science, BWL mit Digital- oder Datenschwerpunkt, Marketing Management mit Analytics-Fokus oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. 
 Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Daten, Technologie und Marketing sinnvoll zusammenspielen.
 Erste praktische Erfahrung aus Praktika, Hochschulprojekten, studentischen Initiativen oder ehrenamtlichem Engagement ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, dich in verschiedene Themen einzuarbeiten.
 Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Analytics-Tools (z.B. Google Analytics 4), mit der Aufbereitung von Daten in Tabellen sowie mit KI-Tools (z.B. Claude) oder CRM-Systemen. Grundkenntnisse in SQL sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
 Du arbeitest sicher mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1).
 Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und selbstständig und hast Lust, dich in MarTech, neue Tools und KI-gestütztes Arbeiten einzuarbeiten.
 Du arbeitest gern mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpersonen zusammen und bist kommunikationsstark.
 

 Warum wir? Faire Vergütung: 18,50 € pro Stunde
Breiter Einblick: Du lernst Analytics, MarTech und datengetriebenes Marketing in einer Rolle kennen.
Echte Verantwortung: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben und siehst die Ergebnisse deiner Arbeit.
Enge Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest im Marketingteam vor Ort und hast feste Ansprechpersonen.
Zentrale Lage: Unser Büro liegt am Ku’damm, bestens angebunden.

Wir bieten dir nicht nur eine Position, sondern eine Plattform, um deine Fähigkeiten zu entfalten und zu wachsen. Werde Teil unseres kleinen Teams mit kurzen Wegen und echtem G

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Document Domain
jobs.description:
PandaDoc is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Document Experience — redefining how professionals create, refine, collaborate on, and complete documents in an increasingly AI-driven world.

You’ll own the strategy and execution of PandaDoc’s core document experiences, shaping how structured content, collaboration, and intelligent assistance come together into cohesive workflows. Your work will help customers move faster from ideas to finalized agreements by making document creation more intuitive, adaptive, and connected.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of user experience, platform systems, and applied AI. You’ll guide multiple squads, align cross-functional partners, and translate emerging technologies into scalable product systems — balancing exploration with disciplined delivery.

In this role, you will

  • Lead high-impact initiatives across document creation, authoring and collaboration experiences.
  • Shape cohesive end-to-end document workflows, ensuring users can move naturally from drafting to completion.
  • Integrate AI capabilities directly into document experiences — including authoring, refinement, structure, and automation — with a focus on real user outcomes.
  • Define product direction for modern document systems, blending structured content, intelligent assistance, and collaborative workflows.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, AI platform, and core platform teams on APIs, integrations, and data models that enable scalable experiences.
  • Collaborate with other senior PMs to ensure consistent, connected journeys across PandaDoc.
  • Drive continuous improvement through experimentation, customer feedback, and product telemetry.
  • Shape the long-term direction of PandaDoc’s Document Domain, ensuring flexibility, coherence, and readiness for evolving AI-powered capabilities.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of hands-on product management experience in B2B SaaS, ideally across document creation, productivity, collaboration, or content platforms.
  • Proven experience owning complex user-facing domains end-to-end — from strategy through delivery and iteration.
  • Familiar with document systems, structured content, and cross-format editing models (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, or AI-generated content).
  • Direct experience shipping AI-powered product features, including defining UX behavior, rollout strategies, and iteration based on real-world usage.
  • Comfortable integrating AI into workflows thoughtfully, focusing on measurable user outcomes rather than standalone capabilities.
  • Skilled in rapid discovery and iteration using prototypes, experiments, and AI-assisted tools.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency — using AI for analysis, prototyping, and workflow automation, with strong judgment to translate ambiguous AI capabilities into dependable product experiences.
  • Strong communicator who simplifies complexity, frames trade-offs clearly, and aligns cross-functional teams.
  • Pragmatic and execution-oriented, balancing experimentation with prioritization and delivery discipline.
  • Comfortable partnering with deeply technical teams on system design, APIs, and platform constraints.

Company Overview: 

PandaDoc empowers more than 67,000 growing organizations to thrive by taking the work out of document workflow. PandaDoc provides an all-in-one document workflow automation platform that helps fast scaling teams accelerate the ability to create, manage, and sign digital documents including proposals, quotes, contracts, and more.  For more information, please visit https://www.pandadoc.com.

Company Culture: 

We're known for our work-life balance, kind co-workers, & creative virtual team-bonding events. And although our Pandas are located across the globe, we stay connected with the help of technology and ensure that everyone on our team feels, well, like a team.

Pandas work best when they're happy. We retain our talent by upholding our values of integrity & transparency, and selling a product that changes the lives of our customers. 

Check out our LinkedIn to learn more.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary. If you are based in Poland, the salary range is 31,000-40,000 PLN per month.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Horizontal Platform Poseidon
jobs.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.

What's Exciting About The Role

This role places you at the centre of Verifone’s payment application strategy for the DACH region. You will shape the terminal application stack that powers one of Europe’s most complex and competitive payment markets — across attended, unattended, SmartPOS, SoftPOS, gateway, and 3rd Party App environments. You will influence product direction across all form factors, drive girocard and next‑generation initiatives like Victa, and own a horizontal product portfolio that touches every merchant segment.

For candidates who want broad ownership, strategic impact, and visibility across engineering, sales, and market leadership, this is one of the most influential product roles in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • BHE Poseidon App roadmap & Book of Work: End-to-end release planning and prioritisation across the DACH product portfolio (Victa series, NEO 2, Engage (until EOL) and future upcoming products) and the software attached to it.
  • Payment methods: Girocard (DK), ICS (International card Schemes, ELV/GLV, APMs, cashback, instalments, in future Wero (EPI) and Digital Euro
  • Customer variants: Like enterprise-specific builds. You know why the same terminal ships six different application variants — and can defend or consolidate that on the roadmap.
  • Estate & terminal management: VHQ 2.0 rollout and adoption, remote update, key management, and certificate management for Verifone and our customers.
  • Certification pipeline: PCI-PTS, P2PE vs non-P2PE, GBIC, DC POS / TA, DK certification cycles — you own the sequencing (not the certification itself) so the sales pipeline never stalls on a missing certificate.
  • Scheme & regulator alignment: Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft (DK), EURO Kartensysteme, Bundesbank/BaFin adjacencies, and equivalent bodies for AT and CH (SIX / EP2).
  • Sales & Ops alignment: Partner to DACH Region management and country sales on Book of Work, feature commitments, and customer escalations — from Partner conferences to enterprise merchants.
  • Engineering & ADC partnership: Tight collaboration with the Poseidon Engineering, and Hardware teams on release readiness, hardware supply topics (spares, EOL), and new form factors.
  • Hardware aspects: Cover the relevant workstreams to make a hardware product sellable in the DACH region.

Skills and Experience We Desire

  • Native or Business fluent German language
  • 5+ years of product management in the DACH/EU payments space — terminal vendor, PSP, acquiring, or network operator.
  • Broad payments fluency: girocard, international card schemes, SoftPOS, APMs, ELV/SEPA — and how a terminal management system (VHQ or equivalent) ties the estate together.
  • Technical foundation: ZVT-H / PSDK / SDI / EP2, EMV kernel, PCI-PTS, P2PE, PSD2 SCA. You do not need to code, but you read Engineering quotes and certification reports on your own.
  • Book of Work discipline: comfortable owning a multi-product, multi-customer release matrix and forcing prioritisation trade-offs.
  • Regulatory instinct: BaFin/ZAG context, DK/GBIC, ZAIT

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft 
 Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
 Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
 Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
 Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
 Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

 Deine Mission 
 KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
 Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
 Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
 Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
 Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.

ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.

 Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.

jobs.description:
Company Description 
 We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 
 
 We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

 Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

 If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

 With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 
 
 About the team 
 Global merchants need better payment performance, resilience and control across providers, markets and payment methods - without building and maintaining the infrastructure themselves.
 We are building Checkout.com ’s next-generation orchestration product: a modular control layer that connects, routes, retries, vaults and reconciles payments across providers through a single integration.
 This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role. You will turn a complex payments problem into a product merchants trust with revenue-critical transactions and financial operations.
 
 What you’ll own 
 Set product strategy for a core part of orchestration, from merchant problem to measurable commercial impact.

 Work directly with enterprise merchants to understand their payment stack and highest-value problems, then turn those insights into a focused roadmap.

 Design reliable experiences across provider connectivity, routing, retries and fallbacks, token portability, reporting and reconciliation.

 Build the foundations: consistent APIs and data models, provider abstraction, observability, auditability and safe change management.

 Lead delivery with engineering, design, commercial, operations, risk, compliance and finance.

 Shape the path from pilot to enterprise adoption, including migration, controlled rollout, rollback and customer co-creation.

 Protect merchant trust by making routing decisions explainable, configurable and provider-neutral.
 

 What success looks like

 You are a systems thinker who can simplify complexity without hiding the important detail.

 You can move from merchant discovery to product strategy, technical trade-offs and executive communication.

 You know how to sequence a modular product around the highest-value use cases, take ownership in ambiguity and follow through.

 Nice to have experience 
 Direct orchestration experience is valuable, but not essential.

 Deep experience in payments, financial infrastructure, developer platforms or other reliability-critical B2B systems is equally relevant.

 
 Additional Information 
 Bring all of you to work

Building the Future of Open Finance 

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.
 The team 
 Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
 Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. Our flagship product allows our clients to instantly buy, sell, convert any combination of stocks, cryptocurrencies and cash. We are constantly working on extending the product suite with new features and improvements.
 
 The opportunity 
 Own the connective tissue between marketing and product at Kraken Consumer — a remit with real scope to shape how millions of people discover and return to our products.

 Build something from the ground up: the roadmap, the intake model and the standards for how marketing and product work together are all yours to define.

 Sit at the centre of the acquisition funnel, where small improvements in conversion compound into meaningful growth.

 Unlock new acquisition channels by building the product surfaces they depend on — paid social, search, affiliates and offline campaigns.

 Shape a fast-growing mobile acquisition motion, including in-product social, creator partnerships, community and friend-referral mechanics.

 Own both halves of the lifecycle: bringing new users in, and giving existing users compelling reasons to come back.

 Work in one of the most competitive corners of consumer fintech, where conversion craft and product quality genuinely decide who wins.

  
  
 What you bring 
 Own the marketing product roadmap end to end, and build the process that turns campaign ideas into shipped product work.

 Design and launch tailored campaign experiences — the in-app and web journeys users land in from push, email, social and paid.

 Raise the bar on lifecycle messaging so push and email feel useful rather than noisy, and convert accordingly.

 Own the incentives layer for new and returning users: offers, referral mechanics, recurring deposits and earn-led campaigns.

 Apply user psychology and sharp UX thinking to find where the funnel leaks, then run the experiments that close the gaps.

 Improve landing page and search performance, and build the product foundations that make paid and offline channels measurable and worth the spend.

 Partner with marketing, design, engineering and data as the single point of ownership for growth enablement.

 Define the acquisition and reactivation metrics that matter, and report on them honestly — including when an experiment doesn't land.

internationalen Vermarktung.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.

 Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
 Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
 Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
 Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
 Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
 Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
 Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
 Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
 Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
 Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
 Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.
 

 We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
 You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
 You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
 You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
 You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
 You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
 You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
 You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
 You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.
 

 What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
 Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
 Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
 €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket

 Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
 We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
 The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
 This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
 What you'll do 
 Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

 Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

 Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

 Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

 Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

 Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

 Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

 Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

 What we're looking for 
 Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

 Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

 AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

 High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

 Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

 Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

 Backgrounds that tend to fit 
 Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

 MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

 Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

 Why this is interesting 
 Competitive, top-of-market compensation

 You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

 Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

 Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

 How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
 Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
 Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
 Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
 Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
 Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
 Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
 Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
 Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
 Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
 Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
 Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
 Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
 Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (All gender)
jobs.description:
About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. 

 Drive Execution:  Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. 

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. 

 

 Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. 

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. 
 

 We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Design (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. Contentful is the composable content platform powering how the world's leading brands create, manage, and deliver digital experiences. These teams enable our platform's evolution as we build AI native features — turning ambitious product strategy into intuitive, well-crafted experiences for the customers and partners who build on Contentful every day. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.

 What To Expect?

  • You'll manage designers across three product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business infrastructure, and design systems. Optimization, Application Foundations and Business Foundations. While all teams strive to deliver solutions for a holistic, unified platform, each has a distinct focus. 
    • Our Optimization group focuses on advancing personalization and analytics capabilities. 
    • Our Application Foundations group includes design systems & information architecture, as well as workflows & automation tooling, and search & discoverability. Notably, the Contentful platform is built on our open source design system, Forma 36. 
    • The Business Foundations group focuses on identity & access, monetization, and platform insights. 
  • You'll manage a team of designers you can genuinely invest in — coaching career growth, shaping how they work, and giving them real ownership over their piece of the platform.
  • You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership on strategy, not just execution to shape how Optimization, Application Foundations, and Business Foundations evolve.
  • You'll help define what AI-native design leadership looks like at Contentful, at a moment when the company is actively maturing that muscle. The Contentful platform includes AI powered customer facing features, and accordingly, we progressively evolve our design tooling and ways of working to take advantage of emerging technologies. 
  • You can be located in or near our London hub. The product designers you manage will be located in EMEA as well, distributed across London, Dublin and our Berlin headquarters. Your manager will be US based and you will collaborate with colleagues globally. 
  • Some travel is expected. The organization typically has training and/or workshops located in our Berlin headquarters, approximately quarterly. 
  • You will be joining at a pivotal moment: Contentful's recent acquisition by Salesforce puts this team's work in front of a massive new customer base, giving you a rare chance to help shape design at a large scale. 

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years directly managing and developing product designers, ideally at a B2B SaaS or platform company.
  • Strong track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership at the strategy level, not just translating requirements. You will influence roadmap decisions, represent design's perspective in cross-functional planning, and drive visioning initiatives. 
  • A strong customer-centric orientation. You ground design and product decisions in real customer insights and instill that same instinct across your team.
  • A track record of design leadership that extends beyond your own team. Experience shaping and evolving the product design function’s practices within an organization. 
  • Maintain a high bar for design craft, with a portfolio reflecting strong interaction and visual design fundamentals. You set and uphold that same bar across your team by giving specific, actionable feedback that sharpens execution, not just strategy.
  • A track record of leading design for complex, multi-team product areas. You should influence a coherent vision that translates across teams supporting a unified platform. 
  • Experience owning or contributing to a design system at scale; familiarity with design systems like Forma 36.
  • Demonstrated success managing distributed, global teams. 
  • A genuine interest in AI-native product design, including shipping AI-powered customer-facing features, as well as evolving design tooling and workflows.
  • Strong portfolio evidence of coaching designers' career growth. Experience facilitating promotions, skill development, and performance management.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).
 Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.
 This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.
 You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!
 
 About hyperexponential (hx) 
 At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
 Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
 Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
 What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
 What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
 If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
 
 About the team 
 Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.
 As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.
 The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.
 Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!
 
 What you'll be doing 
 Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.
 Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.
 Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.
 Become the developer

jobs.title: Product Growth Manager
jobs.description:

 About Nelly 
 We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
 Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
 What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.
 
 Joining us, you will:

 3+ years in product management with hands-on PLG (and ideally PLS) experience: you've built and owned elaborated growth motions on complex B2B workflow products

 High agency and high learning velocity: you run a high volume of hypothesis-driven bets, move fast in ambiguity, say "no" when needed, and are comfortable building from zero

 Strong analytical skills and data mindset around A/B testing, optimization, and defining growth metrics

 Strong data mindset: you create data acquisition and evaluation strategies, track product and agent metrics (utilization rates, precision & recall), understand online vs. offline eval trade-offs, and use insights to drive better customer outcomes

 Passion for AI technology and its potential to reshape product-led growth

 Excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success
 

 Even better if you have: 
 German or Italian proficiency - you can discuss real work with dentists, ZFAs/ZMVs, and billing partners

 Experience growing products for SMB customers in less-digital European verticals (healthcare, construction, legal, architecture, or similar) where adoption is hard-won and not a given

 A fridge full of cold drinks and snacks waiting to be claimed

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (Robotics & Automation)
jobs.description:
About the Role at RobCo 
 RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. 
  
 The Role 
 RobCo goes to market across three streams: Alfie (our emerging, headline-making Physical AI product), Embedded Robotics, and Integrated Solutions. This role owns product marketing for the latter two — together the backbone of RobCo's current business.  Your responsibilities Own and continuously develop product vision, roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for our C++ SDK & ImFusion Suite

 Bring together requirements from customers, internal users, product teams, engineering, and management and translate them into clear priorities.

 Coordinate development activities and releases across teams and components, ensuring that individual efforts contribute to a coherent product.

 Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, capacity, and technical trade-offs.

 Balance short-term delivery needs with technical quality and the long-term development of the product.

 Drive resource planning, support team growth, and gradually take on functional and people leadership.

 
 Who you are You are a systems thinker who can understand a complex technical ecosystem, connect the individual pieces, and maintain sight of the bigger picture.

 You combine genuine technical curiosity with a strong product mindset and a desire to create impact beyond implementation.

 You bring clarity and structure to ambiguous situations without oversimplifying technical complexity.

 You listen to different perspectives but are comfortable challenging assumptions, setting boundaries, and saying no when necessary—regardless of seniority or role.

 You communicate confidently with engineers, scientists, product teams, customers, and management and build trust across these groups.

 You take ownership, follow through, and proactively address risks and obstacles.

 You lead through trust, constructive feedback, sound judgement, and a genuine interest in helping others grow.

 

 Your profile Several years of experience as a software engineer, giving you a solid understanding of programming and software development.

 Subsequent experience owning or coordinating a technically complex software product, platform, or large-scale engineering initiative.

 Experience developing roadmaps, managing requirements, setting priorities, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.

 Experience coordinating, mentoring, or enabling software engineers; previous formal leadership experience is a plus. 

 A strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, testing, technical debt, maintainability, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

 Experience with capacity and resource planning, including translating roadmap needs into staffing or hiring requirements.

 Hands-on experience adapting SDK requirements, architecture, and product roadmaps to advances in AI.

 Experience with developer-facing products or SDKs.

 A background in medical imaging, computer vision, or another technically complex software domain.

 Why us? Shape foundational technologies used across our products and customer projects.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission This is a company built for growth. 
 When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.  
 We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling. 
 As  Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

 Technical product strategy & vision  Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities. 

 Discovery, scoping & prioritization  You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately. 

 Agile ownership & delivery  You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work. 

 Technical stakeholder alignment  You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle. 

 Experimentation & continuous improvement  You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and  technical  improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up. 

 

 What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience  Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations. 

 Engineering fluency  You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer. 

 Agile ownership  You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus. 

 Data-driven product decisions  Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself. 

 High-scale product teams  At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

jobs.description:
About Pelico 
 Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
 We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is seeking a Product Manager - Solutions to help turn complex aerospace and manufacturing operations problems into AI-native, repeatable, and sellable products.
 This role sits at the intersection of customer discovery, product strategy, AI-first workflows, product capabilities, and go-to-market readiness. You will help identify high-value operational problems across customers, translate them into scalable products, and work with Product, Engineering, Customer Operations, Sales, and customers to bring those products to market.
 The mission is not to build bespoke features for individual accounts. It is to discover repeatable patterns, define product narratives, and shape AI-powered workflows that help manufacturers plan, prioritize, detect risks, solve disruptions, and execute decisions faster.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Product Strategy: Contribute to the product vision for one or more product lines — defining customer problems, users, and the operational moments where Pelico creates measurable value, and distinguishing customer-specific requests from scalable product opportunities. Help define success metrics: operational impact, adoption, time saved, and commercial repeatability.

 Product Execution: Work closely with Engineering, Data teams, Operations Researchers, Customer Operations, and Sales to turn messy operational pain points into clear product capabilities and workflows. Help design flows that combine human expertise, optimization, rules, alerts, and automation, and translate what you learn into reusable product requirements so the work strengthens Pelico's core product over time rather than creating one-off, bespoke builds.

 Customer Discovery & Design Partners: Work directly with enterprise customers and design partners to map workflows, constraints, and KPIs, and to shape pilots into scalable deployments rather than one-off delivery projects.

 Go-to-Market Readiness: Help build the product narrative, demo flows, and proof points with Sales and Customer Success so they can articulate it independently, and turn pilot learnings into reusable GTM assets.

 Outcome Ownership: Anchor product decisions in measurable outcomes — operational efficiency, faster risk detection, planning quality, throughput and execution reliability, and strong, repeatable customer adoption.

 AI as an Enabler: Across the above, look for where AI — agents, copilots, recommendations, and automation — can meaningfully remove manual work or support better decisions, and help define how users interact with it (proactive suggestions, explainable outputs, human-in-the-loop approval).
 

 About You 
 Product Management Experience: 4+ years in product management in Enterprise B2B SaaS, with experience turning complex customer problems into product capabilities or product lines

 AI Product Sensibility: Good understanding of how AI — agents, copilots, recommendations, and automation — can augment experts, automate repetitive work, and orchestrate decisions across complex enterprise operations
